summary: Well-structured test suite covering core cleanup logic, config loading, and workflow validation, but has a critical gap: no tests for the CLI parsing logic (src/cli.ts:parseArgs function). Unit tests are comprehensive for retention policies and config validation; act integration tests validate end-to-end pipeline but only cover 2 scenarios. Edge case coverage is partial (missing empty artifact lists, zero policy values, timezone edge cases, and all missing-field combinations in config validation). Design is strong with good fixtures, isolation, determinism (fixed NOW date), and helper functions. Would catch most regressions in cleanup logic but would entirely miss CLI argument-parsing bugs.
